title: Sand ripples and dunes
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of sand with wind or water ripples: asymmetric crests that bend, fork and merge, dark minerals in the troughs, optional dune swells and wet sand. Use for beaches, deserts and riverbeds.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python sand_ripples.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: ripples
parameters.meaning: Ripple crests across the tile along the ripple direction.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.meaning: Crest direction: 0 vertical crests, 1 horizontal crests, 2 and 3 the two diagonals.

parameters.name: meander
parameters.meaning: How much crests bend, fork and merge.

parameters.name: asymmetry
parameters.meaning: Share of each ripple taken by the gentle slope (0.5 symmetric, higher is wind-built).

parameters.name: dune_swell
parameters.meaning: Large low dunes under the ripples.

parameters.name: trough_minerals
parameters.meaning: Dark heavy minerals collected in the troughs.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Dry beach sand with wind ripples.

presets.name: tidal_wet
presets.description: Wet tidal flat with symmetric ripples and dark troughs.

presets.name: desert_dunes
presets.description: Orange desert sand with dune swells and fine ripples.

presets.name: white_gypsum
presets.description: White gypsum sand with long straight ripples.

limits: Ripple direction is limited to four whole-tile directions so the texture repeats. Ripples are a phase field, not a sediment simulation, and do not respond to obstacles. Dune swells are low-frequency height only. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Periodic phase along an integer direction
Asymmetric stoss and lee ripple profile
Phase warping with tileable fractional Brownian motion
Trough darkening from the ripple profile
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
